basics.name: Alina Prytula
basics.label: Content Creator
basics.summary: Content creator with experience producing engaging video, photo, and written content across social platforms. Skilled in scripting, filming, editing, and audience growth, with a strong sense of brand voice and storytelling.

work.name: FoxCool
work.description: Private kindergarten for children ages 2+, built around a caring, playing, and developing philosophy
work.summary: Content creator for a private kindergarten's Instagram, documenting daily activities and building trust with prospective families through warm, story-driven content.
highlights: Filmed and edited short-form video and photo content covering culinary lessons, music and movement classes, outdoor walks, and creative arts and crafts sessions.
Directed and shot parent testimonials to build trust and authenticity with prospective families.
Developed the account's visual identity and storytelling style around the kindergarten's fox mascot and its caring, playing, developing philosophy.
Planned a recurring content calendar aligned with the kindergarten's weekly activities and educational programming.
Worked closely with teachers and caregivers on-site to capture genuine, in-the-moment content without disrupting class activities.

work.name: Norway Butikk
work.description: Volunteer-run charity project selling vintage home decor sourced from Norway in Ukraine, donating 100% of proceeds to Ukrainian military needs
work.summary: Co-founded and ran content and community for a charity resale project, turning secondhand vintage finds from Norway into sales that funded the Ukrainian military.
highlights: Co-founded the project, helping set up its sourcing, logistics, and sales model between Norway and Ukraine.
Wrote and published all product copy and captions for the account, turning secondhand vintage finds into compelling listings.
Created Instagram Stories covering incoming inventory, sales, and charity updates to keep the supporter base engaged.
Managed customer communications, answering inquiries and coordinating sales through Instagram DMs and comments.
Represented the project at offline charity events and markets in Kyiv, selling products directly to raise funds.
Supported a fully volunteer-run operation that donated 100% of proceeds to Ukrainian military needs.
